description: This file implements a PAM (Pluggable Authentication Module) backend for the lighttpd web server, handling authentication requests via PAM. It includes configuration parsing, integration with PAM's API, and handling of authentication logic.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_init
methods.description: Initializes the PAM authentication backend, registers it with the server.

methods.name: void mod_authn_pam_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into the plugin configuration.

methods.name: void mod_authn_pam_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)

methods.name: void mod_authn_pam_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Creates a runtime configuration for handling PAM based on global and per-request settings.

methods.name: mod_authn_pam_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration parameters for the PAM plugin, including processing of configuration directives.

methods.name: int mod_authn_pam_fn_conv(int num_msg,const struct pam_message ** msg,struct pam_response ** resp,void * appdata_ptr)
methods.description: Handles conversion of PAM messages to responses (password prompts).

methods.description: Performs the PAM authentication process, including starting PAM, setting the remote host, and performing authentication and account management.

methods.name: handler_t mod_authn_pam_basic(request_st * const r,void * p_d,const http_auth_require_t * const require,const buffer * const username,const char * const pw)
methods.description: Handles the basic HTTP authentication request, invoking PAM authentication and checking rules.
